place_fields.vibe: A scenic sunset viewpoint over the Western Ghats, with sunset views toward the Arabian Sea on clear days.
place_fields.summary: Kodachadri is a Western Ghats hill destination in the Mookambika Wildlife Sanctuary area; the viewpoint is used for sunset viewing and is reached as part of the Kodachadri trek or jeep route.
place_fields.best_time: Around 5:30 PM–6:30 PM for sunset viewing; October to February generally offers cooler weather and clearer visibility.

planning_attributes.description: Kodachadri Sunset Viewpoint is a scenic viewpoint at Valur/Mudoor Junction associated with Kodachadri, a natural-heritage destination in the Western Ghats.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: Kodachadri rises to over 1,300 metres above sea level.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Kodachadri has religious significance and includes Sarvajna Peetha, a stone meditation site associated with Adi Shankaracharya.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Kodachadri area can be reached by trekking through the forest trail or by jeep; Kollur is the principal base for the approach.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: The Kodachadri area is part of the Mookambika Wildlife Sanctuary, so forest access conditions can apply.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: The approach can involve steep or rocky walking, and the descent after sunset can be difficult in darkness; monsoon conditions can make trails slippery.
planning_attributes.notes: The viewpoint is promoted for sunset views over the surrounding Western Ghats and, on clear days, toward the Arabian Sea.
